bosses.d: A white crocolisk.
A giant violet raptor, leader of the Thicket raptors.
Final boss: a stone Titan construct.

bosses.d: Rare spawn.

bosses.d: At the ritual circle in the Underbelly, surrounded by Kirin Tor Necromancers and rising skeletons. Disarms.
On a round terrace in the streets after leaving the sewers. Casts Arcane Bolt and Focal Blast.
A fel-touched treant in the streets, among Suffused Treants.
An arcane golem by the Magus Commerce Exchange, with Angry Tomes. Malfunction hits everyone within 25 yards.
Rare elite.
Final boss, in the Purple Parlor of the Violet Citadel. Don't stand in line with the Bounding Mana target; he polymorphs the group and resets if someone leaves the room.

ent.d: Enter through the city's sewers: drop through a grate in the streets and follow the Underbelly pipe to the portal

dungeons.d: The irradiated underground city of the gnomes, overrun by troggs and Mekgineer Thermaplugg's forces.

bosses.d: With his pet Chomper, in the trogg cave off the outer ring.
An irradiated ooze in the Hall of Gears.
In the Engineering Labs. Drops the Workshop Key.
In the Launch Bay arena.
Final boss, in Tinkers' Court. Hit the bomb-face buttons to stop the walking bombs.
Rare spawn among the Dark Iron agents.

bosses.d: A quilboar geomancer near the start of the Kraul.
Final boss, deep in the Kraul.
Rare spawn in the bat caves.
Rare spawn.

bosses.d: In the Huntsman's Cloister.
Final boss, in the Athenaeum. Doan's Strongbox behind him holds The Scarlet Key.

dungeons.d: I'lalai, a lost Gurubashi troll city, has risen from the sea off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, west of Grom'gol. Trolls and naga roam the streets of this open-air dungeon, a pirate ship lies wrecked nearby, and the weather builds into a full storm before the final fight. Dive underwater to find the entrance.

bosses.d: First boss, an undead troll. Enrages near death and hits the whole group hard.
Leader of the naga; the Horde quest The Only Good Brinescale... asks for his death. BlizzCon previews called the second boss Zin'aka.
Fought together with a Primeval Elemental.
Fought together with Deathless Marrow.
Final boss: the Gurubashi witch doctor Min'loth, whose seat of power was I'lalai.

loot.note: Risen Sentry / Champion of the Deep / Brinescale Sorceress / Makrura Snapper

ent.d: Underwater west of the Vile Reef: swim to Sunken Hollow by the island with the water elementals; the cave has a large tablet beside it

dungeons.d: The armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery, where the Crusade drills its recruits under the eye of Herod, the Scarlet Champion. The door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from the Library.

bosses.d: Final boss, in the Hall of Champions. When he dies a wave of Scarlet Trainees rushes in.

loot.note: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

ent.d: Inside the Scarlet Monastery; the Armory door needs The Scarlet Key from the Library

dungeons.d: The heart of the Scarlet Monastery: the Chapel Gardens and the Crusader's Chapel, held by Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane. The door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from the Library.

bosses.d: Hidden behind the altar room, through the door at the back of the chapel.
At the altar of the Crusader's Chapel. Whitemane comes to raise him when he falls.
Final boss. Comes out of the back room when Mograine dies and resurrects him.

loot.note: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

ent.d: Inside the Scarlet Monastery; the Cathedral door needs The Scarlet Key from the Library

dungeons.d: The ancient burial grounds of the quilboar, now held by the Scourge. Amnennar the Coldbringer leads the undead from the top of the Downs.

bosses.d: Spider boss. Ring the gong on the Spiral of Thorns to summon him.
In the room with the bone pile and the floating skulls.
On the path up the Downs, after Mordresh.
Rare spawn, near the top of the Downs.
Final boss, at the top of the Downs. Drops the Skull of the Coldbringer for Bring the End.

ent.d: Far south of the Barrens, at the border with Thousand Needles: through the thorny tunnel to the entrance

dungeons.d: An ancient titan vault buried beneath the Badlands, overrun by troggs and Shadowforge dwarves. Archaedas guards the Discs of Norgannon in its deepest chamber.

bosses.d: In the cave before Ironaya's chamber. Drops The Shaft of Tsol for Staff of Prehistoria.
Baelog, Eric "The Swift" and Olaf, fought together in Dig Two. Horde only: they are friendly to the Alliance.
In the Map Chamber. Use the Staff of Prehistoria on the altar to open her door.
Level 42 mechanical guardian near the back entrance to Uldaman, after Ironaya. Drops the Obsidian Power Source for the Mage quest Power in Uldaman.
In the Temple Hall.
In the Dig Three area, past the Shadowforge dwarves.
Trogg leader in the Stone Vault. Drops the sapphire for the necklace quests.
Final boss, in the Chamber of Khaz'Mul. Use the altar to wake him. Drops the power source for the necklace quests.

ent.d: Northern Badlands: through the excavation cave north of Angor Fortress to the stone door at the back

dungeons.d: Ogre outrunners have been kidnapping travelers and raiding settlements across the Riverglades. Their trail leads to a fortress of workshops, encampments and guarded inner passages, where strange chanting is heard after nightfall.

loot.note: Twilight Grunt / Twilight Lieutenant / Redridge Prisoner

ent.d: Northern Riverglades, on the hill above Sunnyglade: not the big fortress gates but the small cave just west of them

dungeons.d: The sun-baked troll city in the deserts of Tanaris, home of the Sandfury tribe and their chief, Ukorz Sandscalp.

bosses.d: Undead Sandfury boss. Drops the First Mosh'aru Tablet for The Prophecy of Mosh'aru.
In the basilisk pit at Sul'lithuz Sandcrawlers. Kill his servants when he calls them.
In the graveyard. Zombies rise from the graves when he is pulled.
Encountered alongside Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz during the Zul'Farrak pyramid event. Also drops Nekrum's Medallion for the Alliance quest.
At the top of the pyramid, after the Sergeant Bly event.

Patrols near the pool and the Gong of Zul'Farrak. Drops the Tiara of the Deep and Second Mosh'aru Tablet for their quests.

Rare spawn, patrols the sand dunes outside the temple.
Rare spawn, on the sand dunes outside the temple.

Final boss, on the top of the temple. One fight together with Ruuzlu.

bosses.d: Orange (Vyletongue) wing. Drops the Celebrian Rod.
Orange wing, patrolling near Noxxion.
Purple wing. Drops the Celebrian Diamond.
Rare spawn in the purple wing.

Goblin engineer in the Foulspore Cavern.
Crocolisk in the waterfall cave below Princess Theradras.
Final boss, in the Earth Song Falls. Zaetar's Spirit appears after her death.

bosses.d: Summoned in the statue circle on the upper level (Secret of the Circle).
Two green dragons guarding the temple. Both must be defeated to complete the encounter. Morphaz also drops items for the hunter, rogue, priest and mage class quests.
Fought together with Ogom the Wretched, after the six troll minibosses on the balconies are dead. Drops the Head of Jammal'an.
Fights beside Jammal'an the Prophet.
Two green dragons encountered after Jammal'an the Prophet. Both must be defeated to complete the encounter.
Final boss, in his lair at the bottom of the temple. Drops the Essence of Eranikus.
Summoned at the central altar with the Filled Egg of Hakkar (The God Hakkar).

ent.d: Swamp of Sorrows: dive into the Pool of Tears and follow the stairs down to the temple door

dungeons.d: The capital of the Dark Iron dwarves beneath Blackrock Mountain: the Detention Block, the Ring of Law, the Grim Guzzler and Shadowforge City, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

Guards the door to the Imperial Seat; the braziers shoot fire while he lives.

dungeons.d: The lower halls of Blackrock Spire, held by the Spirestone, Smolderthorn and Bloodaxe clans of the Dark Horde under Overlord Wyrmthalak.

bosses.d: Rare ogre in the Spirestone area before Highlord Omokk.
Rare ogre near Highlord Omokk.
Rare ogre caster near Highlord Omokk.
Spirestone ogre chief on the ledge in Hordemar City. Drops the Gemstone of Spirestone.
Smolderthorn troll shadow hunter on the way to Voone.
Smolderthorn troll leader in Mok'Doom. Drops the Gemstone of Smolderthorn.
Spider queen in the Skitterweb Tunnels. Get poisoned for Mother's Milk.
Rare spider in the Skitterweb Tunnels.

Bloodaxe worg pack mistress in her den. Gizrul comes out after she dies.

Rare Bloodaxe champion on the bridge to Wyrmthalak.

dungeons.d: The top of Blackrock Spire, held by Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde and General Drakkisath's black dragonflight. The door needs the Seal of Ascension.

bosses.d: Hall of Binding: use the altar to wake him once the Blackhand Incarcerators are dead.
The Rookery: touch the Father Flame and fight off the whelp waves until he arrives.
Rare: sometimes waits in the hall before the Blackrock Stadium.
Dark Horde blacksmith. Use the Blood Stained Pike on him for The Demon Forge.
Blackrock Stadium: Rend's black dragon, released after the arena waves.
Rides Gyth into the Blackrock Stadium and jumps off when the dragon is low.
Giant core hound in its den past the Stadium. Fights back with fireballs and fear.
Summoned with the Brazier of Beckoning from the Dungeon Set 2 quests.
Final boss, in the throne room with his two Chromatic Elite Guards. Guards Drakkisath's Brand.

ent.d: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes: climb to the upper ledge to the Blackrock Spire portal, then through Lower Blackrock Spire to the sealed door

dungeons.d: The eastern quarter of the ruined Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas, overgrown by the Warpwood and ruled by the satyr Alzzin the Wildshaper. Pusillin carries the Crescent Key that opens the other wings.

bosses.d: The imp you chase through the Warpwood Quarter; he fights at the end and drops the Crescent Key.
Satyr at the sacrificial altar in the Warpwood Quarter.
Water elemental in the pool below the bridge.
Blood elf with her pet Pimgib, in the room before Alzzin. Drops Lethtendris's Web.
Final boss, deep in the Warpwood Quarter.

bosses.d: Treant guarding the Capital Gardens.
Rare spawn, stealthed in the Capital Gardens.
Shadow priest on the pylon terraces.
Hunter with her bear Ferra, on the pylon terraces.
Demon in the Prison of Immol'thar; the force field drops once all five pylons are shut down.
Summoned by warlocks in the pentagram near Immol'thar (Dreadsteed of Xoroth).

ent.d: Central Feralas, inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas: the West wing door, opened with the Crescent Key

bosses.d: Ogre guard at the entrance of Gordok Commons.
